title: Headless template retrieval smoke (Phase 3a)
intent: Minimal cast and turns to verify scene_template_id flows into Continuity and template-tagged retrieval in audits.
opening_description: A bare intake cell: metal bench, scratched glass, the hum of the ward beyond the door. Harley and Magpie have been parked here while staff argue about paperwork nobody wants to sign.
trigger_text: Footsteps stop outside. A key scrapes in the lock. Magpie tilts her head; Harley's grin doesn't reach her eyes.
